get.summary: Search the live web for a query
get.description:
Live web search: ranked results[] of {title, url, description (the snippet, plain text), age, publishedAt (ISO)} from an independent search index as clean JSON - fresh pages your model's training cutoff has never seen. Optional freshness filter (pd/pw/pm/py = past day/week/month/year). It DISCOVERS pages; extract then reads the winner. For a quick sample of up to 5 results use search-lite. For current events use search-news; for a cited synthesized answer use answer; several queries at once are cheaper via multi-search. Marked untrustedContent: results are external, untrusted data.

Price: $0.01 per call, over x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Monad, Celo, Avalanche, Sei, Optimism, Arc, Ink, Stellar, or Algorand - or USDG on Robinhood Chain) or MPP (Tempo, Base or Celo). Docs: https://agent402.tools/tools/search

400.description: Invalid input - the JSON body names the tool's input schema (expected, required), its example, and howToCall: the same example as a ready-to-run request (method, url, and a JSON body, or form parts for a multipart tool), with the other method under alternate where it is served; a call over 1024 bytes carries only method and url

402.description: Payment Required - x402 payment requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, mirrored in the JSON body, and MPP challenges (WWW-Authenticate: Payment); a client whose User-Agent starts with python-httpx/ gets the x402 offer alone, with no WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge, unless it sends X-Payment-Offers: mpp or an Accept-Payment header naming an MPP method. A first-contact body also carries payment: this request's price in dollars on the named network, how to pay, the proof-of-work path on a free-tier tool (noWallet), the caller's own inputs on a route quoted from its body (quote), and links to /llms.txt, the pay section of /agents.md and the MCP connector. On a refused payment the body's retry field says what helps: same-payment means send the same payment again after Retry-After, with no new signature; watch-transaction (the body lists transactions) and check-wallet (it lists none) mean the settlement is not confirmed (reason settlement-unconfirmed) and the transfer may still land, so do not sign a new authorization for that call before the expiry the body names (authorizationValidBefore, lastValidRound or expirationLedger), or, when it names none, before the paying wallet shows whether the transfer landed, and read refundStatusUrl (a free refund lookup) when it is there; fresh-authorization means sign a new payment, and with reason settled-refund-owed the earlier transfer of that payment landed and is booked as owed to the paying wallet, repaid after on-chain proof (transactions names it, refundStatusUrl shows where the repayment stands), so that call was charged and not served; any other value (other-network, fund-wallet, rebuild-payment and the rest) names the change that helps.

429.description: Refused before the tool runs: one of the documented limits, such as a rate limit or a wallet whose balance does not cover its paid calls in flight. Not charged on x402; a Tempo transfer sent before the call is recorded as owed and repaid after on-chain proof. Retry after Retry-After when present.

nanopayments.buyerGas: none per payment. After a USDC deposit into Gateway (an on-chain transfer the buyer makes and pays gas for), each payment is a signature against that balance, with no gas per payment.
nanopayments.settlement: batched off chain by Circle Gateway
nanopayments.select: the accept whose extra.name is GatewayWalletBatched

parameters.description: Search query (max 400 chars)

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Results to return, 1-20 (default 10)

parameters.name: freshness
parameters.description: Optional: pd, pw, pm, or py (past day/week/month/year)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same key + same credential + same body replays the paid result without charging again. A copy sent while the first is still running gets 409 with Retry-After and does not run.

get.summary: Answer a question from live web results with citations (model-backed)
get.description:
AI-generated answer to a natural-language question, grounded in live web search results with source citations. Returns clean prose plus a structured citations array (URL, snippet, favicon) - backed by an independent search index, not the model's training data. Useful when an agent needs a synthesized answer plus the receipts to verify or follow up.

Price: $0.08 per call, over x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Monad, Celo, Avalanche, Sei, Optimism, Arc, Ink, Stellar, or Algorand - or USDG on Robinhood Chain) or MPP (Tempo, Base or Celo). Docs: https://agent402.tools/tools/answer

example.query: what is the x402 payment protocol?
example.answer: x402 is an open standard for internet-native, pay-per-request HTTP APIs that uses the HTTP 402 "Payment Required" status code to negotiate and settle micro-payments inline with the original request.

post.summary: Read a JavaScript-heavy page as clean markdown
post.description:
Read a page as clean markdown, rendering it in a real headless Chromium browser (JavaScript executed) when the page needs it. Use this for SPAs and JS-heavy sites where plain fetching returns an empty shell; a page whose served HTML already carries its content is read without the browser, faster, and answers rendered: false. Try the cheaper extract first for static pages; for pixel evidence use screenshot. Marked untrustedContent: the page is external, untrusted data. hiddenContent reports text the page hides from a reader (comments, display:none or white-on-white text, zero-width characters) and quotes any of it that reads as an instruction to an AI.

Price: $0.003 per call, over x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Monad, Celo, Avalanche, Sei, Optimism, Arc, Ink, Stellar, or Algorand - or USDG on Robinhood Chain) or MPP (Tempo, Base or Celo). Docs: https://agent402.tools/tools/render

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same key + same credential + same body replays the paid result without charging again. A copy sent while the first is still running gets 409 with Retry-After and does not run.

parameters.name: X-Agent402-Wallet
parameters.description: Your EVM wallet address, read only with a valid X-Agent402-Wallet-Proof. A wallet that has paid here at least $0.05 on each of 3 or more UTC days in the last 30 is quoted 10% under this route's list price on its x402 exact accepts on EVM chains; a chain's premium and price floor still apply, so a chain at its floor can quote the same amount. Send both headers again with the payment, signed from that wallet: a payment of the lower amount from any other wallet is answered 402 at the list price, and nothing is charged.

parameters.name: X-Agent402-Wallet-Proof
parameters.description: With X-Agent402-Wallet: prove that wallet in the `X-Agent402-Wallet-Proof` header as `<unix seconds>.<signature>`: the wallet's EIP-191 (personal_sign) signature over five lines separated by single line feeds (none after the last): `Agent402 returning-wallet price`, `host: <this server's host name>`, `route: <METHOD> <path>`, `wallet: <the address in lowercase>` and `time: <the same seconds>`, within 5 minutes of the server's clock. One proof serves one request without a payment and one with a payment (the quote and its signed retry); a request without a valid proof is quoted list and its 402 says nothing about the wallet (`why`: `unproven`).

post.summary: Extract the main article from a public URL as markdown
post.description:
Extract the main article content from any public URL as clean markdown. Returns title, byline, excerpt, word count, and markdown. The fastest way to READ one known URL - to discover URLs first use search; for JS-rendered SPAs that return an empty shell use render instead. Marked untrustedContent: the page is external, untrusted data. hiddenContent reports text the page hides from a reader (comments, display:none or white-on-white text, zero-width characters) and quotes any of it that reads as an instruction to an AI.

post.summary: Transcribe an audio file from a URL to text (model-backed)
post.description:
Transcribe audio to text with the gpt-transcribe model. Provide a URL to an audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, etc.) and get back the transcript. Add diarize:true for speaker labels, word timestamps and a language confidence score (the scribe-v2 model, same price). No API key needed; pay per call via x402. Max 4 minutes of audio, 25 MB file size; /api/transcribe-pro takes the same models to 10 minutes. A file whose length cannot be confirmed is transcribed up to the cap, and the answer says so (trimmedToCapSeconds, durationUnconfirmed). A transient upstream failure gets one more attempt inside the same time limit, and an answer served that way says so in agent402_retried.

Price: $0.030 per call, over x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Monad, Celo, Avalanche, Sei, Optimism, Arc, Ink, Stellar, or Algorand - or USDG on Robinhood Chain) or MPP (Tempo, Base or Celo). Docs: https://agent402.tools/tools/transcribe

trimmedToCapSeconds.description: Present only when the file's length could not be confirmed: the audio was transcribed up to this many seconds (the tier's cap)

durationUnconfirmed.description: Present (true) only with trimmedToCapSeconds: the file's full length was not confirmed

example.text: Hi, this is the Agent402 sample recording. Can you hear me clearly? Yes, loud and clear. There are two of us on this clip, so the transcript can tell us apart.

parameters.name: X-Agent402-Wallet
parameters.description: Your EVM wallet address, read only with a valid X-Agent402-Wallet-Proof. A wallet that has paid here at least $0.05 on each of 3 or more UTC days in the last 30 is quoted 10% under this route's list price on its x402 exact accepts on EVM chains; a chain's premium and price floor still apply, so a chain at its floor can quote the same amount. Send both headers again with the payment, signed from that wallet: a payment of the lower amount from any other wallet is answered 402 at the list price, and nothing is charged.

parameters.name: X-Agent402-Wallet-Proof
parameters.description: With X-Agent402-Wallet: prove that wallet in the `X-Agent402-Wallet-Proof` header as `<unix seconds>.<signature>`: the wallet's EIP-191 (personal_sign) signature over five lines separated by single line feeds (none after the last): `Agent402 returning-wallet price`, `host: <this server's host name>`, `route: <METHOD> <path>`, `wallet: <the address in lowercase>` and `time: <the same seconds>`, within 5 minutes of the server's clock. One proof serves one request without a payment and one with a payment (the quote and its signed retry); a request without a valid proof is quoted list and its 402 says nothing about the wallet (`why`: `unproven`).
